name: Exploration
source:
Anna gets threatened by her girlfriend to explore an haunted building, and meets a beautiful stranger, a deadly monster, and possibly romance?

[From [url=https://limulidae.itch.io/exploration]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在女友威脅下，安娜不得不探索一棟鬧鬼的建築。她遇見了一位美麗的陌生人、一頭致命的怪物，沒準還有……愛情？
